svg.title: SuperHost — Newspaper layout — black reconstruction
svg.desc: Expect the most. SuperHost. Reconstructed from the historical reference with twelve unchanged PofBC flag paths, analytic star primitives, and custom letterforms. All artwork is editable vector geometry. No embedded raster or font dependency. Single-colour artwork.

g.data-method: shared brush-skeleton glyphs with mathematical nib sweep; hand reconstructed, original font unverified
g.data-outline-method: cubic curves fitted to mathematical nib-sweep samples, tolerance 0.09 reference unit

g.data-method: eight reusable geometric serif masters; optical fitting; no image tracing
